card.learned_from: Edward Weston《青椒 30 号》（1930）、Irving Penn 的静物（1970 年代）
card.line: 暗棚里一件有分量的金属零件，轮廓光切出形，拆开又带着重量落回去，旁边一张写着材质和质量的说明卡
card.fit: 产品、硬件、工程原理、拆解
card.score: 低沉的电子脉冲，D 小调
card.instruments: 低频长音、合成低音、金属打击
card.sounds_like: 灯亮起一口上扬的气，零件落座一声沉的撞击，螺母拧到底一声脆响

motion.turntable: 60° over the 8 s (a symmetry of every part, so the loop is exact)
motion.drop: lifted with in-out cubic, dropped under gravity (u²) in 0.2 s, a 2 mm bounce that dies in 0.2 s, a small camera shake on the heaviest
motion.camera: 26° lens, dolly 64 → 50 cm-units out-cubic, rises 3° for the explode

texture.light: three softboxes in a PMREM studio (one overhead key, two rim strips behind), a shadow-casting spot, two rim directionals
